reason: No fixed version exists. Reached only via react-native -> metro -> micromatch, which @solana/wallet-adapter-react pulls in for its mobile adapter. metro is a React Native bundler; nothing from that subtree is imported by the browser build or by the relayer/indexer. The DoS requires feeding attacker-controlled glob patterns to braces, which scash never does.

Low severity; flagged for every published version. Reached via circomlibjs -> ethers (v5). scash uses circomlibjs for Poseidon/Baby Jubjub constants only and never calls into ethers' secp256k1 signing; all curve signing in scash goes through @noble.

Reached via @solana/web3.js -> jayson. jayson's streaming JSON-RPC parser is for its server/raw-stream transports; web3.js only uses the HTTP client, which parses whole responses with JSON.parse. No fixed major is adopted by jayson yet.
See GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x: JSONC parser path in jayson that web3.js does not exercise.
See GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x: Assembler path in jayson that web3.js does not exercise.
Affects uuid v3/v5/v6 when a caller-supplied buffer is passed. jayson and rpc-websockets only call uuid.v4() without a buffer. No fixed version is adopted by jayson's range yet.
